hook.en: Iron for tools, copper for wires, gold for jewellery, titanium for aircraft: all are d-block metals. Their special chemistry comes from partly filled d orbitals.
hook.kn: ಉಪಕರಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ, ತಂತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತಾಮ್ರ, ಆಭರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಚಿನ್ನ, ವಿಮಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಟೈಟಾನಿಯಂ: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ d-ವಿಭಾಗದ ಲೋಹಗಳು. ಭಾಗಶಃ ತುಂಬಿದ d ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳೇ ಅವುಗಳ ವಿಶೇಷ ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ.

objectives.en: Locate the d- and f-blocks in the periodic table
Write configurations of transition atoms and ions
Explain why Zn, Cd and Hg are not transition metals

narration.en: Iron for tools, copper for wires, gold for jewellery, titanium for aircraft: all are d-block metals. Their special chemistry comes from partly filled d orbitals.
narration.kn: ಉಪಕರಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ, ತಂತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತಾಮ್ರ, ಆಭರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಚಿನ್ನ, ವಿಮಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಟೈಟಾನಿಯಂ: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ d-ವಿಭಾಗದ ಲೋಹಗಳು. ಭಾಗಶಃ ತುಂಬಿದ d ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳೇ ಅವುಗಳ ವಿಶೇಷ ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ.

body.en: The d-block occupies groups 3 to 12, between the s- and p-blocks. It has four series: 3d (Sc to Zn), 4d (Y to Cd), 5d (La, Hf to Hg) and 6d (Ac, Rf to Cn). A transition element has an incompletely filled d subshell in its atom or in one of its common oxidation states. Zn, Cd and Hg have d¹⁰ in both the atom and their common ions, so they are not regarded as transition metals. The f-block (lanthanoids and actinoids) sits separately at the bottom.
body.kn: d-ವಿಭಾಗವು 3 ರಿಂದ 12 ರವರೆಗಿನ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಸಂಕ್ರಮಣ ಧಾತುವಿನ ಪರಮಾಣು ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಯಾನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ತುಂಬಿದ d ಉಪಕವಚ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. Zn, Cd, Hg ಸಂಕ್ರಮಣ ಧಾತುಗಳೆಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: where the d- and f-blocks sit

say.en: The d-block sits between the s- and p-blocks, groups 3 to 12. The f-block is the two rows set apart at the bottom.
In the d-block the electrons go into the n minus 1 d orbitals; in the f-block into n minus 2 f.
Chromium and copper break the pattern: a half-filled or completely filled d set is extra stable.
Zinc, cadmium and mercury have full d¹⁰ in the atom and in their ions, so they are not counted as transition elements.

text.en: Zn, Cd, Hg: d¹⁰, not transition

body.en: The general configuration is (n−1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². The 4s and 3d energies are very close, so half-filled and completely filled d sets win: Cr is 3d⁵ 4s¹, not 3d⁴ 4s², and Cu is 3d¹⁰ 4s¹, not 3d⁹ 4s². When a transition atom forms an ion, the ns electrons are removed before the (n−1)d electrons.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ (n−1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². ಅರ್ಧ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ಣ ತುಂಬಿದ d ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಿರ: Cr 3d⁵ 4s¹, Cu 3d¹⁰ 4s¹. ಅಯಾನು ಆಗುವಾಗ ಮೊದಲು 4s ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನುಗಳು ಹೊರಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: The general configuration is (n−1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². The 4s and 3d energies are very close, so half-filled and completely filled d sets win: Cr is 3d⁵ 4s¹, not 3d⁴ 4s², and Cu is 3d¹⁰ 4s¹, not 3d⁹ 4s². When a transition atom forms an ion, the ns electrons are removed before the (n−1)d electrons.
narration.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ (n−1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². ಅರ್ಧ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ಣ ತುಂಬಿದ d ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಿರ: Cr 3d⁵ 4s¹, Cu 3d¹⁰ 4s¹. ಅಯಾನು ಆಗುವಾಗ ಮೊದಲು 4s ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನುಗಳು ಹೊರಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: The five d orbitals. Four have four lobes, like dxy shown here; dz² has two lobes and a ring. These are the orbitals being filled across the transition series.

problem.en: Write the electronic configurations of Fe (Z = 26), Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺, and count the unpaired electrons in each ion.

steps.en: Fe²⁺: remove the two 4s electrons → [Ar] 3d⁶: four unpaired electrons (one d orbital holds a pair).
Fe³⁺: remove one more, from 3d → [Ar] 3d⁵: five unpaired electrons, one in each d orbital.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Write the electronic configurations of Fe (Z = 26), Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺, and count the unpaired electrons in each ion.

heading.en: The two rebels of the 3d series

body.en: Only two 3d atoms break the filling order: Cr (24) and Cu (29). Each moves one 4s electron into 3d to get a half-filled or full set.

points.en: Cr 3d⁵ 4s¹ and Cu 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ are the exceptions.
Ions lose the ns electrons first.

homework.en: Write the configurations of Mn²⁺, Cr³⁺ and Cu²⁺.

narration.en: Recap. d-block: groups 3–12; four series 3d, 4d, 5d, 6d. Transition element: incomplete d subshell in the atom or a common ion. Cr 3d⁵ 4s¹ and Cu 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ are the exceptions. Ions lose the ns electrons first.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. d-ವಿಭಾಗ: 3–12 ಗುಂಪುಗಳು; ನಾಲ್ಕು ಶ್ರೇಣಿಗಳು. ಸಂಕ್ರಮಣ ಧಾತು: ಪರಮಾಣು ಅಥವಾ ಅಯಾನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪೂರ್ಣ d ಉಪಕವಚ. Cr ಮತ್ತು Cu ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗಳು ಅಪವಾದಗಳು. ಅಯಾನುಗಳು ಮೊದಲು ns ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.
